plain_description.what: On JudgeBench's external set of 350 answer pairs (one correct, one wrong by an objective check), with no reference shown, it compares a reasoning version of the grok judge with the standard version, using identical prompts. Per-category differences are descriptive only.
plain_description.why: An outside-validity check: does the in-house finding that a reasoning judge is more accurate (+10pp on MMLU-Pro) carry over to an independent benchmark?
plain_description.information: A gain would support using a reasoning judge beyond our own data. No gain would refute that carry-over. Result: not run yet.
